items.title: Introducing Brand Kit and Character Library
items.excerpt: Luma launched Brand Kit and Character Library so uploaded logos, fonts, products and characters stay consistent across every generated image and video, targeting the character drift that keeps AI out of serialized and branded work.
items.rationale: Primary-source product release that tackles character consistency, the main practical blocker for serialized AI video. Creators can use it tomorrow.

items.title: Microdrama revenues hit $20bn in 2026, but profits remain elusive outside China
items.excerpt: A Media Partners Asia report puts global microdrama revenue up 24% to $20bn; about 75% of titles were made using AI, at roughly a tenth of an LA-shot series' cost, while AI accounts for nine in ten Chinese titles but only 20% of revenue.
items.rationale: A new industry report with hard numbers on AI's share of microdrama production and how much revenue it actually earns. On-list outlet.

items.title: Michel Hazanavicius To Present Exclusive Footage Of 'The Third Hand' In AI Case Study At Les Arcs
items.excerpt: Oscar winner Michel Hazanavicius and post house Digital District will show exclusive footage of The Third Hand at Les Arcs Film Festival in December, explaining the method and AI tools used to make the film.
items.rationale: Fresh announcement: an Oscar-winning director will openly walk through the AI pipeline behind his film. Rare transparency at a time when AI use draws backlash.

items.title: Netflix AI clause divides Germany's dubbing industry over voice training rights
items.excerpt: German voice actors including Katrin Froehlich (Cameron Diaz), Anne Helm (Margot Robbie) and Luise Helm (Scarlett Johansson) refuse to sign a Netflix contract clause letting it use their voices to train AI, so they will no longer dub those stars on Netflix.
items.rationale: A concrete labour development: named star-voice actors are refusing Netflix's AI-training clause and losing roles over it. This is separate from the Klemm lawsuit carded 11-06.

items.title: 일레븐랩스, 국내 AI 단편제작 프로젝트 '더 콜라보레이션 2026'에 기술 파트너로 참여

items.rationale: Follow-up with a new action: ElevenLabs has been named the audio technology partner, and the finished films premiere at today's (11-27) showcase. It also adds a Korean angle and a fifth outlet.
